Verify And Decrypt Webhook Submission.description: Checks the FormSG webhook signature and decrypts the submission in one step.

Decrypt Submission.description: Decrypts a FormSG submission without checking the signature.

Decrypt Submission With Signature Check.description: Decrypts a submission and verifies its webhook signature first.

Verify Webhook Signature.description: Verifies that an incoming webhook really came from FormSG.
Verify Webhook Signature.code:
// Throws if the signature is invalid; otherwise state.data is { verified: true, ... }.
verifyWebhook($.request.headers['x-formsg-signature']);

Map Responses To Answers By Question.description: Decrypts a submission and turns the responses array into a simple question-to-answer object.
